name: Alexis Leskinen
original_name: アレクシス・レスキネン
source: Alexis Leskinen is a professor at Victor Chondria University and the mentor of Hiyajou Maho and  Makise Kurisu. He is also a senior researcher at the Brain Research Institute.
translation: Alexis Leskinen is a professor at Victor Chondria University and the mentor of Hiyajou Maho and  Makise Kurisu. He is also a senior researcher at the Brain Research Institute.
